item.title: Building a Django Development Environment with Vagrant
item.description: Docker solves the problem of environment isolation on the same machine and improves the efficiency of operations and deployment. Vagrant gives developers a unified, near-fully-isolated environment for development and testing. This article mainly discusses how to build a Django development environment with Vagrant. Versions: VirtualBox 5.0, Vagrant 1.8. 1. Basic
